records.source: It takes plaque images, folders of them, both mixed, and any number of PDFs in the chosen preview mode; other files dropped with them are left aside quietly. Before this handler Plaque Assay was given Make Masks' policy, which refused a folder it could not use with Make Masks' sentence.
records.translation: 它接受斑块图像、包含这些图像的文件夹、两者的混合输入，以及所选预览模式下任意数量的 PDFs；与它们一起拖入的其他文件会被静默忽略。在此处理器之前，Plaque Assay 使用 Make Masks 的策略；该策略会以 Make Masks 的提示语拒绝其无法使用的文件夹。

records.source: The mode follows what was dropped: PDFs, or a folder of them, dropped in Plaque mode ask whether to switch to Figure mode; images dropped in Figure mode ask to switch to Plaque mode. PDFs and images together ask which to read. A PDF-only drop opens Live in the chosen mode; mixed drops read only the chosen input type.
records.translation: 模式随拖入的内容而定：在 Plaque 模式中拖入 PDFs 或包含这些文件的文件夹时，会询问是否切换到 Figure 模式；在 Figure 模式中拖入图像时，会询问是否切换到 Plaque 模式。同时拖入 PDFs 和图像时，会询问要读取哪一类。仅拖入 PDF 时，会以所选模式打开 Live；混合拖入时，只读取所选输入类型。
